Gradient-boosted trees for storm-object tornado probability over CONUS: P(tornado report within 40 km in the next 60 min | ProbSevere storm object). 41 features (Block P ProbSevere + Block E evolution + Block H HRRR atm + Block C coherence field theory). output_schema.calibration: Platt (sigmoid(a*F + b)) fitted on the full 2023 validation population

entries.name: HazardPulse Earthquake operational forecast v1 (candidate C0, base of the served S1)
entries.description: P(at least one ComCat M6.0+ epicentre in the 2-degree cell within the next 30 days) for every cell of the global grid, from boosted trees (LightGBM, scored in NumPy) over its long-term smoothed-seismicity rate, an ETAS-style short-term clustering rate and recent catalog counts of ComCat M5+ events since 1973 strictly before the issue time. Parameters fitted by Bernoulli likelihood on weekly issue times 2005-2017; chosen on 2018-2020 by a pre-registered information-gain rule with a parsimony clause; scored once on 2023-2025 (docs/EARTHQUAKE_FORECAST_PROGRAM.md). The artifact holds the parameters and the frozen M5+ catalog; live events after its cutoff come from the scorer's USGS fetch.

input_schema.inputs: ComCat events M>=5.0 with origin time strictly before the issue time (1973 onward)

output_schema.calibration: none applied: the trees' log-loss fit over every FIT cell-time (negatives sampled 5% at weight 20)

benchmark.benchmark_type: operational forward test on every cell-time of the grid (not case-control)
benchmark.test_window: weekly issue times 2023-01-02 .. 2025-12-01, 30-day windows, read once

lineage.registration: sections 1-8 frozen before the first fit; their SHA-256 is recorded in section 9

entries.name: HazardPulse Earthquake operational forecast S1 (C0 + GEAR1, served)
entries.description: P(at least one ComCat M6.0+ epicentre in the 2-degree cell within the next 30 days) for every cell: logit p = a + c logit(p_C0) + b log10 G, with p_C0 from eq_operational_C0_v1-d28c62a2e35b and G the GEAR1 long-term rate (Bird et al. 2015; geodetic strain + smoothed seismicity; CC-BY-4.0) on the grid. Weights fitted on 2018-2020, decided on 2021-2022 against C0 recalibrated on the same years (docs/EARTHQUAKE_FORECAST_PROGRAM.md section 10); 2023-2025 is a declared second read.

output_schema.calibration: the stack's logistic weights (fitted by Bernoulli likelihood on 2018-2020)

benchmark.benchmark_type: operational forward test on every cell-time of the grid (not case-control)
benchmark.test_window: weekly issue times 2023-2025, 30-day windows (a declared second read)

entries.name: HazardPulse Hurricane RI v9.1 (shadow, in prospective verification)
entries.description: LightGBM on the early intensity aids' 24-h changes, NOAA's RI probabilities at six thresholds and the official forecast; DTOPS where the early guidance is missing. Recorded on every live NHC cycle beside NOAA's published number, never instead of it; chosen by a pre-registered rule (docs/HURRICANE_RI_V9_PROGRAM.md, protocol + amendment 1).

entries.name: HazardPulse Hurricane RI v10.1 (shadow, in prospective verification)
entries.description: one threshold-stacked exceedance curve P(dV24 >= k), k = 15-45 kt, on v9's inputs; shown on the site beside NOAA's published number (results/hurricane_prospective/shown_model.json). Recorded on every live NHC cycle beside NOAA's published number, never instead of it; chosen by a pre-registered rule (docs/HURRICANE_RI_V9_PROGRAM.md, amendment 2).

entries.name: HazardPulse Hurricane RI v10.2 (shadow, in prospective verification)
entries.description: v10.1 with monotone constraints on the guidance and NOAA's probabilities. Recorded on every live NHC cycle beside NOAA's published number, never instead of it; chosen by a pre-registered rule (docs/HURRICANE_RI_V9_PROGRAM.md, amendments 3-4).

entries.name: HazardPulse Hurricane RI v10.3 (shadow, in prospective verification)
entries.description: v10.2 plus 14 cloud-top structure features from NOAA GMGSI infrared (t+2 h and t-4 h). Recorded on every live NHC cycle beside NOAA's published number, never instead of it; chosen by a pre-registered rule (docs/HURRICANE_RI_V9_PROGRAM.md, amendments 5-6).

entries.name: HazardPulse Hurricane RI v10.4 (shadow, in prospective verification)
entries.description: v10.3 plus 4 balanced-response features: the coherence equation solved for the heating the vortex holds inside its local Rossby radius. Recorded on every live NHC cycle beside NOAA's published number, never instead of it; chosen by a pre-registered rule (docs/HURRICANE_RI_V9_PROGRAM.md, amendments 8-9).

entries.name: HazardPulse Hurricane RI J1 (JTWC basins, shadow, in test beside v8.2)
entries.description: LightGBM (5 seeds, averaged) on v8.2's probability (as a logit), its 17 inputs, 14 NOAA GMGSI infrared cloud-top features and basin indicators; trained on storms of 2022-2025, all six basins (v8.2 is out of sample on every one). Registered hindcast 2024-2025, every JTWC cycle pooled with crops on best-track positions: log loss 0.13360 vs v8.2 0.14121, carried. Recorded on every live WP, IO, SH storm beside v8.2, never instead of it; shown on the site and judged only in its scope (WP, SI, results/calibration/hurricane_ri_j2.json). Its prospective test (scripts/score_hurricane_j1_prospective.py, looks 2026-12-01, 2027-12-01) decides whether it becomes the published number.

further_read.declared: 2026 JTWC basins to date: a further read, no claim

lineage.trained: storms of 2022-2025, all six basins (v8.2 is out of sample on every one)

entries.name: HazardPulse TC1 track and intensity forecast (NHC areas, shown beside NHC's official forecast)
entries.description: Track and intensity to 120 h for every storm the National Hurricane Center follows: a minimum-variance combination of NHC's real-time early aids, each weighted online by its verified errors (exponential forgetting, shrinkage toward the diagonal, non-negative weights). Each scorer run replays the season from the saved models (amendment 1). Settings chosen on 2021-2022, tested on 2023-2025 against NHC's official forecast; no claim against it was met.

entries.name: HazardPulse Earthquake GBT v1 (plus_cft) -- NOT SERVED
entries.description: Not served: the site's earthquake probability is the operational forecast entry (docs/EARTHQUAKE_FORECAST_PROGRAM.md). Gradient-boosted tree ensemble for global M6+ earthquake probability per 2-degree grid cell, 30-day forward window. 73 features = Block S (61 seismicity) + Block C (12 coherence field theory). Trained on declustered USGS catalog 2005-2017, validated 2018-2019, tested 2020-2024 (plus_cft variant of trained_models_v3). The benchmark below is a CASE-CONTROL NOWCAST (positives scored at the mainshock setting against controls); as an operational forecaster on a gridded forward test this model scored AUC 0.509 -- no skill (docs/earthquake_nowcast_validation.md).

output_schema.calibration: logit-link via boosted trees

benchmark.benchmark_type: case-control nowcast, not an operational forecast
benchmark.test_window: USGS M6+ events 2020-2024

entries.name: HazardPulse Hurricane RI v8.2 (ensemble, pinned)
entries.description: Rapid-intensification ensemble (histogram-GBT depth 3 + depth 4 + L2 logistic + bagged logistic) predicting a >= 30 kt wind increase in the next 24 h, on true synoptic timestamps. Served from a pinned file bound to its training-data hash; calibrated by a converged Newton logistic fit on seasons the members never trained on. Held-out test: 298 storms first seen 2022-2024, 507 RI events. Since 2026-10-02 it serves the JTWC basins and any NHC cycle without NOAA's SHIPS text; NHC-basin cycles with it are served the NOAA aid entry below.

output_schema.calibration: logistic_on_logit_newton fitted on held-out seasons

benchmark.test_window: storms first seen 2022-2024 (bootstrap by storm)

entries.name: HazardPulse Hurricane RI, NHC basins: NOAA aid stack v1 (candidate A)
entries.description: P(>= 30 kt wind increase in 24 h) for Atlantic, East and Central Pacific storms from NOAA's operational RI guidance: DTOPS raw (SHIPS-RII where DTOPS is missing: Amendment 1, item 1). Read live from NHC's SHIPS text for the storm's cycle; chosen among six pre-registered candidates (DTOPS, SHIPS-RII, RI consensus, and three logistic stacks of the NOAA aids, one with HazardPulse v8.2) by forward chaining on 2020-2024 under a parsimony rule (docs/HURRICANE_RI_PROGRAM.md); scored once on the 2025 season.

input_schema.source: NHC SHIPS text 'Matrix of RI probabilities', column 30/24 (ATCF e-deck RI records in training)
input_schema.representation: ATCF e-deck whole percent; live SHIPS text: SHIPS-RII from SHIPS's own whole-percent line, every other row rounded half-up (hazardpulse.hurricane.ships_text)

output_schema.calibration: none: NOAA's probability as issued

benchmark.test_window: 2025 season, NHC-basin cycles with a SHIPS-RII record, read once
